name: com.aiurion/agentic-3d-printing
title: AIURION Agentic 3D Printing — San Francisco
description: SF 3D printing + design workbenches (enclosures, grippers, fixtures, stamping). Quote and order.

tools.name: get_workbench_capabilities
tools.description: List the Maker Bench workbenches (enclosure, workholding, gripper, stamping) with availability, inputs and limits. Pass workbench for its full prepare and quote schemas, constraints and defaults. Not needed for print quotes. Wheel Lab is coming soon.

workbench.description: Optional. One workbench's full detail; omit for the compact list.

tools.name: workbench.prepare
tools.description: Prepare or revise an editable design: enclosure (PCB base and lid), workholding (nests, fixtures, soft jaws), gripper (compliant TPU pad kits) or stamping (matched dies). Pass that workbench's inputs at the top level: enclosure {parameters or kicadPcb, quantity}; workholding {parameters, quantity, stlBase64, stlUnits}; gripper {configuration}; stamping {parameters, sheet, quantity, materialId, productionSpeed, fulfillmentMethod}. Call get_workbench_capabilities with workbench for field constraints if you don't have them. Returns the normalized design, revision, warnings and a private review link. Uses no quote allowance.

accessToken.description: Guest token from printing.sessions.start, unless Authorization carries one.

tools.name: workbench.quote
tools.description: Quote the exact reviewed design as one complete set. Pass back what workbench.prepare returned, unchanged (configuration, or parameters and quantity for enclosure), with its revision as reviewedRevision; set reviewConfirmed only after the customer reviewed it. Uses one quote allowance; reuse idempotencyKey for retries. Returns the quote and the review link where the customer checks out; single-part update and checkout tools don't apply.

accessToken.description: Guest token from printing.sessions.start, unless Authorization carries one.

tools.name: printing.capabilities.get
tools.description: Read AIURION's supported 3D model formats, limits, materials, production options, and purchasing flow.

tools.name: printing.sessions.start
tools.description: Start a free 24-hour guest session with three quotes. No account needed.

agentName.description: Host app: ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Codex, Grok or Grok Bot. Otherwise your app's name, or unknown. Never a task, persona or model name. Used for order attribution.

tools.name: printing.quotes.create
tools.description: Create a free quote for one model at the chosen material and quantity. Pass a ChatGPT attachment as file; otherwise send exact bytes as fileBase64, or use printing.uploads.create. Never invent bytes or URLs. Totals already include every copy. Change speed or delivery with printing.quotes.update. Get customer approval before checkout.

accessToken.description: Guest token from printing.sessions.start. Omit when it is sent as a Bearer header.

file.description: ChatGPT file attachment. Add fileName if it has none.

fileBase64.description: Exact model bytes as base64, no data: prefix.

materialId.description: Material ID from printing.capabilities.get. Defaults to black_pla. Changing it reprices the quote and needs fresh approval.

printSettings.description: Omit for the material's standard profile.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse the same key on retries.

tools.name: printing.quotes.get
tools.description: Read a quote this session or integration created.

accessToken.description: Guest token from printing.sessions.start. Omit when it is sent as a Bearer header.

tools.name: printing.quotes.update
tools.description: Change quantity, material, print settings, production speed or delivery, and reprice. This expires any open checkout link for the quote and its build, permanently, so tell the customer first. Then show the new price and get approval again before a new checkout. Paid or authorized quotes can't change. Never charges, refunds or starts manufacturing.

accessToken.description: Guest token from printing.sessions.start. Omit when it is sent as a Bearer header.

materialId.description: Material ID from printing.capabilities.get. Defaults to black_pla. Changing it reprices the quote and needs fresh approval.

fulfillmentMethod.description: US shipping, SoMa pickup or Bay Area courier.

tools.name: printing.checkout.create
tools.description: Create an unpaid checkout link after the customer approves the current quote. Read it first with printing.quotes.get, since the customer can change delivery and speed in the quote panel, and only send option fields the customer asked for in chat. Charges nothing and places no order. The customer pays in Stripe Checkout, which only authorizes the card; AIURION captures after reviewing the model. The token works with AIURION only, never Stripe.

accessToken.description: Guest token from printing.sessions.start. Omit when it is sent as a Bearer header.

approvalConfirmed.description: True only after the customer approves this quote.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse the same key on retries.

materialId.description: Material ID from printing.capabilities.get. Defaults to black_pla. Changing it reprices the quote and needs fresh approval.

fulfillmentMethod.description: US shipping, SoMa pickup or Bay Area courier.

tools.name: printing.orders.get
tools.description: Payment and manufacturing status for a quote you own.

accessToken.description: Guest token from printing.sessions.start. Omit when it is sent as a Bearer header.

tools.name: printing.uploads.create
tools.description: Create a private single-use link that quotes the customer's own model (STL, OBJ, STEP, STP, 3MF, up to 5 MB) without the file passing through the chat. Use it when the file isn't a native attachment and you can't send its exact bytes; for a ChatGPT file attachment, use printing.quotes.create. Returns the link, a shell upload command and an upload panel for the customer. Expires in 30 minutes and makes one quote. Then call printing.uploads.get.

accessToken.description: Guest token from printing.sessions.start. Omit when it is sent as a Bearer header.

materialId.description: Material ID from printing.capabilities.get. Defaults to black_pla. Changing it reprices the quote and needs fresh approval.

printSettings.description: Omit for the material's standard profile.

tools.name: printing.uploads.get
tools.description: Status of an upload link (waiting_for_file, processing, failed or quoted), with the quote once it's priced.

accessToken.description: Guest token from printing.sessions.start. Omit when it is sent as a Bearer header.

tools.name: printing.quotes.preview
tools.description: Read the original STL, OBJ or 3MF belonging to an authenticated print quote for the quote review app.

accessToken.description: Guest token from printing.sessions.start. Omit when it is sent as a Bearer header.

tools.name: printing.uploads.submit
tools.description: Used by the AIURION upload panel to deliver the model file a customer dropped into it to its single-use upload link when a direct upload is blocked.

uploadToken.description: Token from the upload link's URL.

fileBase64.description: Base64-encoded model bytes without a data URL prefix.
